messages:
maya: Getting a spike of GPU warm-pool join failures in eu-west-1, and audit shipper backlog is huge. nodes failing to decrypt keystore blobs. logs show KMS Deny with condition mismatch.
ranjit: omg, saw the same. natgw egress costs jumping from audit retries. linking logs...
maya: paste log: `ERROR keystore: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException (Condition: StringEquals kms:EncryptionContext:project != "redwood-core")`
jen: tagging oncall. @oncall can you confirm any KMS policy rollout?
auditbot: Alert: keystore-decrypt-errors > 1000 in 5m (eu-west-1). Audit shipper retries queued: 120k.
oliver: security pushed a tightening last night to add encryptionContext=redwood-core for cross-account decrypt. We expected no impact but looks like some ephemeral keystore blobs were created without ctx.
kevin: which service wrote those blobs? warmpool uses ephemeral keystore via keystore-proxy in each region, should include ctx. maybe older nodes prewarm used the old flow.
alice: I think this started when we rotated the cross-account key on the centralized auditor role. Some auditors re-encrypted with new params.
maya: consequence: nodes can't join => autoscaler can't refill pools => throttled capacity for customer workloads.
jen: short-term mitigation options: 1) roll back key policy 2) add Decrypt exception for keystore proxy principal 3) re-encrypt blobs with ctx. what's fastest?
oliver: security preference is avoid rollback. adding exception for `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-proxy-eu` to kms:Decrypt with no encryptionContext condition is fastest. Need approval from keystore-owner.
ranjit: downside: that widens key access surface. But if we scope it to `kms:ViaService` + source VPC maybe ok.
kevin: I can open a temporary key policy change and scope ttl=2h. rolling it out now would fix joins quickly. then re-encrypt backlog.
maya: natgw egress costs right now are ~£1.5k extra / hr due to audit shipper retries to S3. We should also throttle retries.
alice: we can flip audit shipper to use VPC endpoint s3 (no nat) as fallback. but that requires IAM change on shipper task role to use endpoint. smaller blast radius.
jen: proposal: 1) kevin applies tight-temporary KMS exception for keystore-proxy principal with condition {SourceVpce: vpce-0abc} TTL 2h 2) keystore team re-encrypt blobs with correct ctx 3) audit shipper retries throttled and switched to S3 VPC endpoint 4) postmortem and key rotation runbook update. agreed?
ranjit: +1 from infra. I can throttle shipper retries via feature flag to exponential backoff right now.
oliver: security +1 but we need logged approval in ticket. I'll create ticket and CLM signoff.
kevin: doing the KMS patch now (`aws kms put-key-policy --key-id alias/central-audit-key --policy file://tmp-exception.json`). Will notify when done.
deploy_bot: keystore-proxy-eu: rolling restart initiated (3 pods).
maya: after restart, 6 nodes joined warm-pool, decrypt errors dropping to single digits. audit backlog decreasing.
jen: can someone own cost alerting for the next 24h? set to pager threshold if natgw cost > £5000/day.
alice: assigning to ranjit for immediate alerts, me for the longer-term VPC endpoint change.
oliver: will file the security ticket and add required condition patterns to the KMS policy template so future rotations don't break this.
maya: thanks team. we'll track follow-ups in the ticket. temporary exception expires in 2h per plan.
kevin: KMS policy patch applied at 1717012400, verified decrypt success for keystore-proxy.
jen: marking thread resolved for ops now but keep postmortem task open. :thumbsup:
